n242756fe32.summary: Adjustments to MSCI index weights periodically trigger large stock market volume spikes and price movements.
n242756fe32.why: MSCI indexes are widely followed benchmarks; changes affect portfolio allocations and can drive market volatility.
n242756fe32.why_moved: MSCI index weight changes prompt portfolio rebalancing, causing market volume and price fluctuations.
